title: Coroner's inquest announced to examine death of man in RCMP custody
article: The BC Coroners Service has announced a public inquest into the death of a man who died after he was arrested by the Kelowna RCMP last year.
Forty-year-old Brandt Zimmer died in hospital on Aug. 15, 2010, about an hour after Mounties attempted to arrest him at a Kelowna go-kart track.
At the time, police reported that Zimmer entered the track wearing only underwear, running over top video games and frothing at the mouth.
Zimmer went into medical distress during the arrest and officers performed first-aid, but he died in hospital.
Coroner Mark Coleman and a jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determine the facts surrounding Zimmer's death and make recommendations to prevent similar deaths.
